<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Saved Cars & Trips | RentRide</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       RESET & VARIABLES
    ============================================================ */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --navy:       #101D32;
      --navy-deep:  #0a1221;
      --teal:       #14B8A6;
      --teal-dark:  #0d9488;
      --grey:       #F4F7FA;
      --amber:      #F59E0B;
      --white:      #ffffff;
      --text:       #1e293b;
      --muted:      #64748b;
      --danger:     #ef4444;
      --danger-dk:  #dc2626;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      background: var(--grey);
      color: var(--text);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       HEADER
    ============================================================ */
    header {
      background: var(--navy);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    }

    .nav-wrap {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 68px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0;
    }

    /* Logo */
    .logo {
      text-decoration: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-right: 32px;
    }
    .logo-svg { width: 28px; height: 20px; }
    .logo-name { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; }
    .logo-name .r  { color: var(--white); }
    .logo-name .g  { color: var(--teal); }

    /* Nav links */
    .nav-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2px;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .nav-links > li > a,
    .more-btn {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.88);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: .9rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      padding: 7px 13px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      transition: background .18s, color .18s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav-links > li > a:hover,
    .nav-links > li > a.active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: var(--white); }
    .nav-links > li > a.active { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 7px 7px 0 0; }

    /* Home icon tiny */
    .home-icon { font-size: .85rem; }

    /* More dropdown */
    .more-wrap { position: relative; }
    .more-btn {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 7px;
    }
    .more-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
    .more-btn .chevron { font-size: .65rem; transition: transform .2s; }
    .more-btn[aria-expanded="true"] .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    .mega-menu {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 14px);
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
      width: 440px;
      padding: 22px 24px 18px;
      z-index: 2000;
    }
    .mega-menu.open { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 24px; }

    .mm-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .mm-group h5 {
      font-size: .68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .09em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      padding-bottom: 5px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e9eef5;
    }
    .mm-group a {
      display: block;
      color: var(--text);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: .88rem;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: background .15s, color .15s;
    }
    .mm-group a:hover, .mm-group a.active { background: #f0fdfa; color: var(--teal); }

    /* Right side */
    .nav-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-left: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .icon-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--white);
      width: 38px; height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .18s;
      position: relative;
    }
    .icon-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
    .badge {
      position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 3px;
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px;
      font-size: .58rem; font-weight: 700;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border: 2px solid var(--navy);
    }

    .btn-book {
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      border: none;
      padding: 9px 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: .88rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
    }
    .btn-book:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* Hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none; border: none;
      cursor: pointer; padding: 4px;
    }
    .hamburger span {
      width: 24px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all .3s;
    }

    /* Mobile nav */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      padding: 12px 24px 20px;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-nav a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 10px 0;
      font-size: .93rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    }
    .mobile-nav a:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    /* ============================================================
       MAIN
    ============================================================ */
    main {
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 44px 24px 56px;
    }

    /* Breadcrumb */
    .breadcrumb {
      font-size: .82rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .breadcrumb a { color: var(--teal); text-decoration: none; }
    .breadcrumb a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
    .breadcrumb span { color: var(--muted); }

    /* Page heading */
    .page-h1 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .page-sub {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: .95rem;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }

    /* Section header */
    .sec-title {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .sec-title::after {
      content: '';
      flex: 1;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--teal) 0%, transparent 100%);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       CAR CARDS GRID
    ============================================================ */
    .cars-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }

    .car-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(16,29,50,.08);
      transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
      animation: fadeUp .4s ease both;
    }
    .car-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 36px rgba(16,29,50,.14);
    }
    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .car-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dde6f0 0%, #c5d2e0 100%);
    }
    .car-img-fallback {
      width: 100%; height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dde6f0, #c5d2e0);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3.5rem;
    }
    .img-wrap { position: relative; }
    .car-pill {
      position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px;
    }
    .car-pill.amber { background: var(--amber); }
    .car-pill.navy  { background: var(--navy); }

    .card-body { padding: 18px 20px 20px; }
    .car-name {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }
    .car-price {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: .97rem;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .car-price small { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; font-size: .82rem; }

    .card-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; }

    .btn-remove {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--danger);
      color: var(--danger);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      transition: background .2s, color .2s;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    }
    .btn-remove:hover { background: var(--danger); color: var(--white); }

    .btn-view {
      background: var(--teal);
      border: none;
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      transition: background .2s;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .btn-view:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }

    /* ============================================================
       EMPTY STATE
    ============================================================ */
    .empty-state {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 64px 24px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(16,29,50,.07);
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }
    .empty-state.show { display: flex; }
    .empty-emoji { font-size: 4.5rem; margin-bottom: 18px; opacity: .55; }
    .empty-title {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .empty-desc {
      color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem;
      max-width: 300px; line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 26px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       EXPLORE BUTTON (reusable)
    ============================================================ */
    .btn-explore {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      border: none; padding: 12px 26px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      font-weight: 600; font-size: .93rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
    }
    .btn-explore:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }

    /* ============================================================
       UPCOMING TRIPS

    .trip-card {

<script>
  'use strict';

  /* ─── DEFAULT DATA seeded on first visit ─────────────────────── */
  const DEFAULTS = [
    {
      id: 1,
      name: 'Toyota Corolla',
      price: '$45',
      badge: 'Popular',
      badgeClass: '',
      img: 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/2019_Toyota_Corolla_sedan_%28China%2C_facelift%2C_burgundy%29%2C_front_8.3.19.jpg/640px-2019_Toyota_Corolla_sedan_%28China%2C_facelift%2C_burgundy%29%2C_front_8.3.19.jpg'
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      name: 'Honda City',
      price: '$38',
      badge: 'Economy',
      badgeClass: 'amber',
      img: 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2e/2020_Honda_City_1.5_V_CVT_%28GM7%2C_Philippines%29%2C_front_8.14.21.jpg/640px-2020_Honda_City_1.5_V_CVT_%28GM7%2C_Philippines%29%2C_front_8.14.21.jpg'
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      name: 'Suzuki Swift',
      price: '$30',
      badge: 'Compact',
      badgeClass: '',
      img: 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5b/2017_Suzuki_Swift_SZ5_ALLGRIP_1.0_Front.jpg/640px-2017_Suzuki_Swift_SZ5_ALLGRIP_1.0_Front.jpg'
    },
    {
      id: 4,
      name: 'BMW 5 Series',
      price: '$120',
      badge: 'Luxury',
      badgeClass: 'navy',
      img: 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/67/2017_BMW_530i_%28G30%29_sedan_%282018-08-27%29_01.jpg/640px-2017_BMW_530i_%28G30%29_sedan_%282018-08-27%29_01.jpg'
    }
  ];

  const LS_KEY = 'rentride_saved_cars';

  /* ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function load() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY);
      if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch(e) {}
    save(DEFAULTS);
    return [...DEFAULTS];
  }

  function save(cars) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(cars)); } catch(e) {}
  }

  /* ─── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let cars = load();
  let pendingId = null;

  /* ─── Render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function render() {
    const grid  = document.getElementById('carsGrid');
    const empty = document.getElementById('emptyState');
    const badge = document.getElementById('savedBadge');

    // Update badge
    badge.textContent = cars.length;
    badge.style.display = cars.length > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';

    if (cars.length === 0) {
      grid.innerHTML = '';
      grid.style.display = 'none';
      empty.classList.add('show');
      return;
    }

    empty.classList.remove('show');
    grid.style.display = 'grid';

    grid.innerHTML = cars.map((car, i) => /* html */`
      <article class="car-card" style="animation-delay:${i * 0.07}s" role="listitem" aria-label="${car.name}">
        <div class="img-wrap">
          <img
            class="car-img"
            src="${car.img}"
            alt="${car.name}"
            loading="lazy"
            onerror="this.outerHTML='<div class=car-img-fallback aria-hidden=true>🚗</div>'"
          />
          <span class="car-pill ${car.badgeClass}">${car.badge}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
          <h3 class="car-name">${car.name}</h3>
          <p class="car-price">${car.price} <small>/ day</small></p>
          <div class="card-actions">
            <button
              class="btn-remove"
              onclick="openModal(${car.id})"
              aria-label="Remove ${car.name} from saved cars"
            >
              <svg width="13" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 16" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M5.5 1h3a.5.5 0 0 1 .5.5V2h3a.5.5 0 0 1 0 1H2a.5.5 0 0 1 0-1h3v-.5A.5.5 0 0 1 5.5 1zM3 4h8l-.8 9.6A1 1 0 0 1 9.2 14H4.8a1 1 0 0 1-1-.4L3 4z"/>
              </svg>
              Remove
            </button>
            <button class="btn-view" aria-label="View details for ${car.name}">View Details</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    `).join('');
  }

  /* ─── Modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function openModal(id) {
    pendingId = id;
    const ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
    ov.classList.add('open');
    document.getElementById('btnConfirm').focus();
    // Trap focus
    trapFocus(ov);
  }

  function closeModal() {
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('open');
    pendingId = null;
  }

  document.getElementById('btnCancel').addEventListener('click', closeModal);

  document.getElementById('btnConfirm').addEventListener('click', () => {
    cars = cars.filter(c => c.id !== pendingId);
    save(cars);
    closeModal();
    render();
    toast('Car removed from saved list.');
  });

  // Close on backdrop click
  document.getElementById('overlay').addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeModal();
  });

  // Close on Escape
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
  });

  // Simple focus trap
  function trapFocus(el) {
    const focusable = el.querySelectorAll('button, [href], input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])');
    const first = focusable[0], last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    el.addEventListener('keydown', function handler(e) {
      if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
      if (e.shiftKey) { if (document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); } }
      else            { if (document.activeElement === last)  { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); } }
      if (!el.classList.contains('open')) el.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
    });
  }

  /* ─── Toast ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let toastTimer;
  function toast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('toast');
    document.getElementById('toastMsg').textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
  }

  /* ─── More dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const moreBtn  = document.getElementById('moreBtn');
  const megaMenu = document.getElementById('megaMenu');

  moreBtn.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const open = megaMenu.classList.toggle('open');
    moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    megaMenu.classList.remove('open');
    moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  });
  megaMenu.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());

  // Close dropdown on Escape
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      megaMenu.classList.remove('open');
      moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    }
  });

  /* ─── Hamburger ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('hamburger').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const nav  = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const btn  = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const open = nav.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });

  /* ─── Trip Details ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function showTripDetails() {
    alert('🚗 Honda Civic\n📍 Islamabad → 🏔️ Murree\n📅 Status: Upcoming\n\nFull trip details page coming soon!');
  }

  /* ─── Init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  render();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

  <style>
    /* ============================================================
       RESET & VARIABLES
    ============================================================ */
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --navy:       #101D32;
      --navy-deep:  #0a1221;
      --teal:       #14B8A6;
      --teal-dark:  #0d9488;
      --grey:       #F4F7FA;
      --amber:      #F59E0B;
      --white:      #ffffff;
      --text:       #1e293b;
      --muted:      #64748b;
      --danger:     #ef4444;
      --danger-dk:  #dc2626;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      background: var(--grey);
      color: var(--text);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       HEADER
    ============================================================ */
    header {
      background: var(--navy);
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    }

    .nav-wrap {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
      height: 68px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0;
    }

    /* Logo */
    .logo {
      text-decoration: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-right: 32px;
    }
    .logo-svg { width: 28px; height: 20px; }
    .logo-name { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1; }
    .logo-name .r  { color: var(--white); }
    .logo-name .g  { color: var(--teal); }

    /* Nav links */
    .nav-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 2px;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .nav-links > li > a,
    .more-btn {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.88);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: .9rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      padding: 7px 13px;
      border-radius: 7px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      transition: background .18s, color .18s;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav-links > li > a:hover,
    .nav-links > li > a.active { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); color: var(--white); }
    .nav-links > li > a.active { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 7px 7px 0 0; }

    .home-icon { font-size: .85rem; }

    /* More dropdown */
    .more-wrap { position: relative; }
    .more-btn {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 7px;
    }
    .more-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
    .more-btn .chevron { font-size: .65rem; transition: transform .2s; }
    .more-btn[aria-expanded="true"] .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    .mega-menu {
      display: none;
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 14px);
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
      width: 440px;
      padding: 22px 24px 18px;
      z-index: 2000;
    }
    .mega-menu.open { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 24px; }

    .mm-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .mm-group h5 {
      font-size: .68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .09em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      padding-bottom: 5px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e9eef5;
    }
    .mm-group a {
      display: block;
      color: var(--text);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: .88rem;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: background .15s, color .15s;
    }
    .mm-group a:hover, .mm-group a.active { background: #f0fdfa; color: var(--teal); }

    /* Right side */
    .nav-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-left: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .icon-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--white);
      width: 38px; height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .18s;
      position: relative;
    }
    .icon-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
    .badge {
      position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 3px;
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px;
      font-size: .58rem; font-weight: 700;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border: 2px solid var(--navy);
    }

    .btn-book {
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      border: none;
      padding: 9px 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: .88rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
    }
    .btn-book:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* Hamburger */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none; border: none;
      cursor: pointer; padding: 4px;
    }
    .hamburger span {
      width: 24px; height: 2px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all .3s;
    }

    /* Mobile nav */
    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--navy);
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      padding: 12px 24px 20px;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-nav a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 10px 0;
      font-size: .93rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    }
    .mobile-nav a:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    /* ============================================================
       MAIN
    ============================================================ */
    main {
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 44px 24px 56px;
    }

    /* Breadcrumb */
    .breadcrumb {
      font-size: .82rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .breadcrumb a { color: var(--teal); text-decoration: none; }
    .breadcrumb a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    /* Page heading */
    .page-h1 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .page-sub {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: .95rem;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
    }

    /* Section header */
    .sec-title {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .sec-title::after {
      content: '';
      flex: 1;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--teal) 0%, transparent 100%);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       CAR CARDS GRID
    ============================================================ */
    .cars-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }

    .car-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(16,29,50,.08);
      transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
      animation: fadeUp .4s ease both;
    }
    .car-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 10px 36px rgba(16,29,50,.14);
    }
    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .car-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dde6f0 0%, #c5d2e0 100%);
    }
    .car-img-fallback {
      width: 100%; height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dde6f0, #c5d2e0);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      font-size: 3.5rem;
    }
    .img-wrap { position: relative; }
    .car-pill {
      position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px;
      background: var(--teal);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: .7rem; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 20px;
    }
    .car-pill.amber { background: var(--amber); }
    .car-pill.navy  { background: var(--navy); }

    .card-body { padding: 18px 20px 20px; }
    .car-name {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 5px;
    }
    .car-price {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: .97rem;
      color: var(--teal);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .car-price small { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; font-size: .82rem; }

    .card-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; }

    .btn-remove {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--danger);
      color: var(--danger);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      transition: background .2s, color .2s;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    }
    .btn-remove:hover { background: var(--danger); color: var(--white); }

    .btn-view {
      background: var(--teal);
      border: none;
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 9px;
      font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 500;
      cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      transition: background .2s;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .btn-view:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); }

    /* ============================================================
       EMPTY STATE
    ============================================================ */
    .empty-state {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 64px 24px;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(16,29,50,.07);
      margin-bottom: 52px;
    }
    .empty-state.show { display: flex; }
    .empty-emoji { font-size: 4.5rem; margin-bottom: 18px; opacity: .55; }
    .empty-title {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .empty-desc {
      color: var(--muted); font-size: .92rem;
      max-width: 300px; line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: 26px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       EXPLORE BUTTON
    ============================================================ */
    .btn-explore {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      border: none; padding: 12px 26px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      font-weight: 600; font-size: .93rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
    }
    .btn-explore:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }

    /* ============================================================
       UPCOMING TRIPS
    ============================================================ */
    .trips-section { margin-bottom: 52px; }

    .trip-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(16,29,50,.08);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
    }
    .trip-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(16,29,50,.13);
    }

    .trip-thumb {
      width: 130px; height: 86px;
      border-radius: 11px;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dde6f0, #c5d2e0);
    }
    .trip-thumb img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }

    .trip-info { flex: 1; }
    .trip-car {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 7px;
    }
    .trip-route {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      font-size: .88rem; color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .route-arr { color: var(--teal); font-size: 1rem; }
    .trip-status-pill {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
      background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e;
      font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 20px;
    }

    .btn-details {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--teal);
      color: var(--teal);
      padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background .2s, color .2s;
    }
    .btn-details:hover { background: var(--teal); color: var(--white); }

    /* ============================================================
       EXPLORE CTA BANNER
    ============================================================ */
    .cta-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, #1b3058 100%);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 44px 32px;
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .cta-banner h3 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .cta-banner p {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.65);
      font-size: .95rem; margin-bottom: 26px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       MODAL
    ============================================================ */
    .overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed; inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,.52);
      z-index: 3000;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
    }
    .overlay.open { display: flex; }

    .modal {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 22px;
      padding: 40px 36px;
      max-width: 420px; width: 90%;
      text-align: center;
      box-shadow: 0 24px 72px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
      animation: popIn .3s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) both;
    }
    @keyframes popIn {
      from { transform: scale(.8); opacity: 0; }
      to   { transform: scale(1);  opacity: 1; }
    }

    .modal-icon { font-size: 3.2rem; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .modal h3 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .modal p {
      color: var(--muted); font-size: .91rem;
      line-height: 1.65; margin-bottom: 28px;
    }
    .modal-btns {
      display: flex; gap: 12px; justify-content: center;
    }
    .btn-cancel {
      background: var(--grey); border: none;
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 11px 24px; border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .2s;
    }
    .btn-cancel:hover { background: #dde4ee; }
    .btn-confirm {
      background: var(--danger); border: none;
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 11px 24px; border-radius: 10px;
      font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 600;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .2s;
    }
    .btn-confirm:hover { background: var(--danger-dk); }

    /* ============================================================
       TOAST
    ============================================================ */
    .toast {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 28px; right: 28px;
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 20px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-size: .88rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.26);
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      z-index: 9999;
      transform: translateY(90px); opacity: 0;
      transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), opacity .35s;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--teal);
    }
    .toast.show { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }

    /* ============================================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================================ */
    footer {
      background: #0a1221;
      color: var(--white);
      padding: 52px 24px 36px;
    }
    .foot-inner {
      max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.9fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
    }
    .foot-brand h2 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em;
      color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .foot-brand p {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.58);
      font-size: .88rem; line-height: 1.72;
      margin-bottom: 20px; max-width: 290px;
    }
    .foot-copy { color: rgba(255,255,255,.35); font-size: .8rem; }
    .foot-col h4 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .foot-col ul { list-style: none; }
    .foot-col ul li { margin-bottom: 11px; }
    .foot-col ul li a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.62);
      text-decoration: none; font-size: .88rem;
      transition: color .2s;
    }
    .foot-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    /* ============================================================
       RESPONSIVE
    ============================================================ */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .cars-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links, .btn-book { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .nav-wrap { justify-content: space-between; }
      .foot-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .trip-card { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .trip-thumb { width: 100%; height: 160px; }
      .btn-details { align-self: flex-start; }
      .page-h1 { font-size: 1.65rem; }
      .cta-banner { padding: 32px 20px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      main { padding: 28px 16px 48px; }
      .modal { padding: 28px 20px; }
      .modal-btns { flex-direction: column; }
      .modal-btns button { width: 100%; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

    {

      img: 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/2e/2020_Honda_City_1.5_V_CVT_%28GM7%2C_Philippines%29%2C_front_8.14.21.jpg/640px-2020_Honda_City_1.5_V_CVT_%28GM7%2C_Philippines%29%2C_front_8.14.21.jpg'

      img: 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/5/5b/2017_Suzuki_Swift_SZ5_ALLGRIP_1.0_Front.jpg/640px-2017_Suzuki_Swift_SZ5_ALLGRIP_1.0_Front.jpg'
    },
    {
      id: 4, name: 'BMW 5 Series', price: '$120', badge: 'Luxury', badgeClass: 'navy',
      img: 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/67/2017_BMW_530i_%28G30%29_sedan_%282018-08-27%29_01.jpg/640px-2017_BMW_530i_%28G30%29_sedan_%282018-08-27%29_01.jpg'
    }
  ];

  const LS_KEY = 'rentride_saved_cars';

  function load() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY);
      if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch(e) {}
    save(DEFAULTS);
    return [...DEFAULTS];
  }

  function save(cars) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(cars)); } catch(e) {}
  }

  let cars = load();
  let pendingId = null;

  /* ─── Render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function render() {
    const grid  = document.getElementById('carsGrid');
    const empty = document.getElementById('emptyState');
    const badge = document.getElementById('savedBadge');

    badge.textContent = cars.length;
    badge.style.display = cars.length > 0 ? 'flex' : 'none';

    if (cars.length === 0) {
      grid.innerHTML = '';
      grid.style.display = 'none';
      empty.classList.add('show');
      return;
    }

    empty.classList.remove('show');
    grid.style.display = 'grid';

    grid.innerHTML = cars.map((car, i) => `
      <article class="car-card" style="animation-delay:${i * 0.07}s" role="listitem" aria-label="${car.name}">
        <div class="img-wrap">
          <img class="car-img" src="${car.img}" alt="${car.name}" loading="lazy"
               onerror="this.outerHTML='<div class=car-img-fallback aria-hidden=true>🚗</div>'" />
          <span class="car-pill ${car.badgeClass}">${car.badge}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="card-body">
          <h3 class="car-name">${car.name}</h3>
          <p class="car-price">${car.price} <small>/ day</small></p>
          <div class="card-actions">
            <button class="btn-remove" onclick="openModal(${car.id})" aria-label="Remove ${car.name} from saved cars">
              🗑️ Remove
            </button>
            <button class="btn-view" aria-label="View details for ${car.name}">View Details</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </article>
    `).join('');
  }

  /* ─── Modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function openModal(id) {
    pendingId = id;
    const ov = document.getElementById('overlay');
    ov.classList.add('open');
    document.getElementById('btnConfirm').focus();
  }

  function closeModal() {
    document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('open');
    pendingId = null;
  }

  document.getElementById('btnCancel').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  document.getElementById('btnConfirm').addEventListener('click', () => {
    cars = cars.filter(c => c.id !== pendingId);
    save(cars);
    closeModal();
    render();
    showToast('Car removed from saved list.');
  });
  document.getElementById('overlay').addEventListener('click', e => {
    if (e.target === e.currentTarget) closeModal();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeModal(); megaMenu.classList.remove('open'); moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); }
  });

  /* ─── Toast ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('toast');
    document.getElementById('toastMsg').textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
  }

  /* ─── More dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const moreBtn  = document.getElementById('moreBtn');
  const megaMenu = document.getElementById('megaMenu');

  moreBtn.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const open = megaMenu.classList.toggle('open');
    moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    megaMenu.classList.remove('open');
    moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  });
  megaMenu.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());

  /* ─── Hamburger ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('hamburger').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const nav  = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const btn  = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const open = nav.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });

  /* ─── Trip Details ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function showTripDetails() {
    alert('🚗 Honda Civic\n📍 Islamabad → 🏔️ Murree\n📅 Status: Upcoming\n\nFull trip details page coming soon!');
  }

  /* ─── Init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  render();
</script>

</body>

       FOOTER
    ============================================================ */

      max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;

      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800;

      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 700;

    .foot-col ul li { margin-bottom: 11px; }

    .foot-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    /* ============================================================
       TOAST
    ============================================================ */
    .toast {
      position: fixed; bottom: 28px; right: 28px;
      background: var(--navy); color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: .88rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.26);

      transform: translateY(90px); opacity: 0;
      transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), opacity .35s;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--teal);
    }
    .toast.show { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }

    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      main { padding: 28px 16px 48px; }

    }

  'use strict';

  /* ─── Keys ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const LS_USERS    = 'rr_users';
  const LS_SESSION  = 'rr_session';

  /* ─── Built-in demo account ──────────────────────────────────── */
  const DEMO = {
    name:      'Demo Member',
    email:     'demo@rentride.com',
    password:  'Demo@123',
    memberID:  'RR-100001',
    startDate: '01 Jan 2025',
    year:      '2025'
  };

  /* ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function getUsers() {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_USERS) || '[]'); } catch(e) { return []; }
  }
  function saveUsers(arr) {
    localStorage.setItem(LS_USERS, JSON.stringify(arr));
  }
  function getSession() {
    try { return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(LS_SESSION) || 'null'); } catch(e) { return null; }
  }
  function setSession(user) { sessionStorage.setItem(LS_SESSION, JSON.stringify(user)); }
  function clearSession()   { sessionStorage.removeItem(LS_SESSION); }

  function isValidEmail(e) { return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(e.trim()); }

  /* ─── Screens ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const $login     = document.getElementById('loginScreen');
  const $signup    = document.getElementById('signupScreen');
  const $dashboard = document.getElementById('dashboardScreen');

  function showScreen(which) {
    $login.style.display     = which === 'login'     ? '' : 'none';
    $signup.style.display    = which === 'signup'    ? '' : 'none';
    $dashboard.style.display = which === 'dashboard' ? '' : 'none';

    // Adjust main alignment for dashboard (needs more width)
    const main = document.getElementById('mainArea');
    main.style.justifyContent = which === 'dashboard' ? 'flex-start' : 'center';
    main.style.paddingTop     = which === 'dashboard' ? '44px' : '48px';
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }

  /* ─── Password toggle ────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function togglePw(id, btn) {
    const inp = document.getElementById(id);
    const show = inp.type === 'password';
    inp.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
    btn.textContent = show ? '🙈' : '👁️';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', show ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password');
  }

  /* ─── Alert helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function setAlert(id, msg, type) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.className = 'auth-alert show ' + type;
    el.innerHTML = (type === 'error' ? '❌ ' : '✅ ') + msg;
  }
  function clearAlert(id) {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.className = 'auth-alert';
    el.textContent = '';
  }

  /* ─── Field error helpers ────────────────────────────────────── */
  function fieldErr(inputId, errId, show) {
    document.getElementById(inputId).classList.toggle('error', show);
    document.getElementById(errId).classList.toggle('show', show);
  }

  /* ─── LOGIN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('loginForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    clearAlert('loginAlert');

    const email = document.getElementById('loginEmail').value.trim();
    const pass  = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;

    let valid = true;
    if (!isValidEmail(email)) { fieldErr('loginEmail','loginEmailErr',true); valid = false; }
    else                       { fieldErr('loginEmail','loginEmailErr',false); }
    if (pass.length < 6)       { fieldErr('loginPassword','loginPassErr',true); valid = false; }
    else                       { fieldErr('loginPassword','loginPassErr',false); }
    if (!valid) return;

    // Check demo account first
    let user = null;
    if (email.toLowerCase() === DEMO.email.toLowerCase() && pass === DEMO.password) {
      user = { ...DEMO };
    } else {
      // Check localStorage accounts
      const stored = getUsers().find(u => u.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase() && u.password === pass);
      if (stored) user = stored;
    }

    if (!user) {
      setAlert('loginAlert', 'Incorrect email or password. Please try again.', 'error');
      return;
    }

    setSession(user);
    loadDashboard(user);
    showScreen('dashboard');
    showToast('Welcome back, ' + user.name.split(' ')[0] + '! ✨');
  });

  /* ─── SIGN UP ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('signupForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    clearAlert('signupAlert');

    const name  = document.getElementById('signupName').value.trim();
    const email = document.getElementById('signupEmail').value.trim();
    const pass  = document.getElementById('signupPassword').value;

    let valid = true;
    if (!name)             { fieldErr('signupName','signupNameErr',true);  valid = false; }
    else                   { fieldErr('signupName','signupNameErr',false); }
    if (!isValidEmail(email)) { fieldErr('signupEmail','signupEmailErr',true);  valid = false; }
    else                      { fieldErr('signupEmail','signupEmailErr',false); }
    if (pass.length < 6)   { fieldErr('signupPassword','signupPassErr',true);  valid = false; }
    else                   { fieldErr('signupPassword','signupPassErr',false); }
    if (!valid) return;

    // Check duplicate
    const users = getUsers();
    if (email.toLowerCase() === DEMO.email.toLowerCase() ||
        users.find(u => u.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase())) {
      setAlert('signupAlert', 'An account with this email already exists.', 'error');
      return;
    }

    // Build new user
    const now      = new Date();
    const months   = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
    const startDate = `${String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')} ${months[now.getMonth()]} ${now.getFullYear()}`;
    const uid       = 'RR-' + (200000 + users.length + 1);

    const newUser = {
      name, email, password: pass,
      memberID:  uid,
      startDate: startDate,
      year:      String(now.getFullYear())
    };

    users.push(newUser);
    saveUsers(users);

    setAlert('signupAlert', 'Account created! Signing you in…', 'success');

    setTimeout(() => {
      setSession(newUser);
      loadDashboard(newUser);
      showScreen('dashboard');
      showToast('Account created! Welcome, ' + name.split(' ')[0] + '! 🎉');
    }, 1200);
  });

  /* ─── Navigation between screens ────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('goSignUp').addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    clearAlert('loginAlert');
    document.getElementById('loginForm').reset();
    showScreen('signup');
  });
  document.getElementById('goLogin').addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    clearAlert('signupAlert');
    document.getElementById('signupForm').reset();
    showScreen('login');
  });

  /* ─── LOGOUT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('logoutBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    clearSession();
    document.getElementById('loginForm').reset();
    showScreen('login');
    showToast('You have been signed out.');
  });

  /* ─── Load dashboard ─────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function loadDashboard(user) {
    document.getElementById('dashName').textContent   = user.name.split(' ')[0];
    document.getElementById('infoName').textContent   = user.name;
    document.getElementById('infoEmail').textContent  = user.email;
    document.getElementById('infoMID').textContent    = user.memberID;
    document.getElementById('infoStart').textContent  = user.startDate;
    document.getElementById('infoYear').textContent   = user.year;
    document.getElementById('passName').textContent   = user.name;
    document.getElementById('passMID').textContent    = 'ID: ' + user.memberID;
    document.getElementById('passStart').textContent  = user.startDate;
    buildBarcode();
  }

  /* ─── Decorative barcode ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  function buildBarcode() {
    const container = document.getElementById('barcodeStrips');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    const widths  = [2,1,3,1,2,1,4,1,2,3,1,2,1,3,2,1,4,1,2,1,3,2,1,2,3,1,2,1,3,4,1,2,1,2,3,1,2,4,1,2];
    const heights = [32,20,28,16,32,22,30,18,28,24,32,20,26,32,22,18,30,24,28,32,20,26,32,18,24,30,22,32,20,28];
    widths.forEach((w, i) => {
      const s = document.createElement('span');
      s.style.width  = w + 'px';
      s.style.height = (heights[i % heights.length]) + 'px';
      s.style.opacity = (.2 + Math.random() * .4).toFixed(2);
      container.appendChild(s);
    });
  }

  /* ─── Toast ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let _t;
  function showToast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('toast');
    document.getElementById('toastMsg').textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(_t);
    _t = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
  }

  /* ─── More dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const moreBtn  = document.getElementById('moreBtn');
  const megaMenu = document.getElementById('megaMenu');
  moreBtn.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const open = megaMenu.classList.toggle('open');
    moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    megaMenu.classList.remove('open');
    moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  });
  megaMenu.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { megaMenu.classList.remove('open'); moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); }
  });

  /* ─── Hamburger ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('hamburger').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const nav  = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const btn  = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const open = nav.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });

  /* ─── Init: check existing session ──────────────────────────── */
  (function init() {
    const session = getSession();
    if (session) {
      loadDashboard(session);
      showScreen('dashboard');
    } else {
      showScreen('login');
    }
  })();
</script>

</body>

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --navy:      #101D32;
      --navy-deep: #0a1221;
      --teal:      #14B8A6;
      --teal-dark: #0d9488;
      --teal-lite: #f0fdfa;
      --grey:      #F4F7FA;
      --amber:     #F59E0B;
      --amber-lt:  #fef3c7;
      --white:     #ffffff;
      --text:      #1e293b;
      --muted:     #64748b;
      --danger:    #ef4444;
      --success:   #10b981;
      --border:    #e2e8f0;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      background: var(--grey);
      color: var(--text);
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       HEADER
    ============================================================ */
    header {
      background: var(--navy);
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 1000;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    }
    .nav-wrap {
      max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px; height: 68px;
      display: flex; align-items: center;
    }
    .logo {
      text-decoration: none; display: flex;
      align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0; margin-right: 32px;
    }
    .logo-name {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1;
    }
    .logo-name .r { color: var(--white); }
    .logo-name .g { color: var(--teal); }

    .nav-links {
      list-style: none; display: flex;
      align-items: center; gap: 2px; flex: 1;
    }
    .nav-links > li > a, .more-btn {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.88); text-decoration: none;
      font-size: .9rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      padding: 7px 13px; border-radius: 7px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
      transition: background .18s; cursor: pointer;
    }
    .nav-links > li > a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.1); }
    .nav-links > li > a.active {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--teal);
      border-radius: 7px 7px 0 0;
    }

    .more-wrap { position: relative; }
    .more-btn {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
      color: var(--white); border-radius: 7px;
    }
    .more-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
    .chevron { font-size: .65rem; transition: transform .2s; display: inline-block; }
    .more-btn[aria-expanded="true"] .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

    .mega-menu {
      display: none; position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 14px); left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--white); border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
      width: 440px; padding: 22px 24px 18px; z-index: 2000;
    }
    .mega-menu.open { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 24px; }

    .mm-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .mm-group h5 {
      font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 6px;
      padding-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e9eef5;
    }
    .mm-group a {
      display: block; color: var(--text);
      text-decoration: none; font-size: .88rem;
      padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px;
      transition: background .15s, color .15s;
    }
    .mm-group a:hover, .mm-group a.active { background: #f0fdfa; color: var(--teal); }

    .nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-left: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .icon-btn {
      background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--white);
      width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s; position: relative;
    }
    .icon-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
    .badge {
      position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 3px;
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px;
      font-size: .58rem; font-weight: 700;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border: 2px solid var(--navy);
    }
    .btn-book {
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      border: none; padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 24px;
      font-weight: 600; font-size: .88rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
    }
    .btn-book:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

    .hamburger {
      display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
      background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px;
    }
    .hamburger span { width: 24px; height: 2px; background: var(--white); border-radius: 2px; }

    .mobile-nav {
      display: none; flex-direction: column;
      background: var(--navy); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      padding: 12px 24px 20px;
    }
    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }
    .mobile-nav a {
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); text-decoration: none;
      padding: 10px 0; font-size: .93rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    }
    .mobile-nav a:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

    /* ============================================================
       MAIN
    ============================================================ */
    main {
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%; padding: 48px 24px 64px;
    }

    /* Breadcrumb */
    .breadcrumb {
      font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    }
    .breadcrumb a { color: var(--teal); text-decoration: none; }
    .breadcrumb a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

    /* Hero heading */
    .page-hero {
      text-align: center; margin-bottom: 52px;
    }
    .hero-eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      background: var(--teal-lite); color: var(--teal-dark);
      border: 1px solid #99f6e4;
      font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700;
      padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase;
    }
    .page-h1 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.2;
    }
    .page-h1 span { color: var(--teal); }
    .page-sub {
      color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.05rem; max-width: 520px; margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* Section title */
    .sec-title {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    }
    .sec-title::after {
      content: ''; flex: 1; height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--teal), transparent);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       OFFER CARDS ROW
    ============================================================ */
    .offers-section { margin-bottom: 52px; }

    .offers-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .offer-card {
      border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px 24px;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
      cursor: default;
      animation: fadeUp .4s ease both;
    }
    .offer-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.14); }

    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .offer-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: .05s; }
    .offer-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .12s; }
    .offer-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .19s; }

    /* Card variants */
    .offer-card.teal {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal) 0%, var(--teal-dark) 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(20,184,166,.28);
    }
    .offer-card.amber {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--amber) 0%, #d97706 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(245,158,11,.28);
    }
    .offer-card.navy {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, #1b3058 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(16,29,50,.28);
    }

    /* Decorative circle */
    .offer-card::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute;
      width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      top: -50px; right: -40px;
    }
    .offer-card::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute;
      width: 90px; height: 90px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      bottom: -20px; left: 20px;
    }

    .offer-icon {
      font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 14px;
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .offer-pct {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2.8rem; font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 6px;
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .offer-label {
      font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .offer-desc {
      font-size: .82rem; opacity: .8;
      line-height: 1.55;
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .offer-code-tag {
      display: inline-block; margin-top: 14px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);
      padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .06em; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      position: relative; z-index: 1; cursor: pointer;
      transition: background .2s;
    }
    .offer-code-tag:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.28); }
    .offer-code-tag::before { content: '📋 '; font-family: sans-serif; }

    /* ============================================================
       PROMO & DISCOUNT CALCULATOR
    ============================================================ */
    .calc-section { margin-bottom: 52px; }

    .calc-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 24px; padding: 36px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 32px rgba(16,29,50,.09);
    }

    /* Inputs row */
    .calc-inputs {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
    .field label {
      font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--navy);
    }
    .field-hint { font-size: .75rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }

    .input-wrap { position: relative; }
    .input-prefix {
      position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; font-weight: 600;
      pointer-events: none; user-select: none;
    }
    .has-prefix input { padding-left: 52px; }

    .field input {
      width: 100%; padding: 13px 16px;
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius: 11px;
      font-size: .95rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      color: var(--text); background: var(--grey);
      transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; outline: none;
    }
    .field input:focus {
      border-color: var(--teal);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(20,184,166,.12);
      background: var(--white);
    }
    .field input.error  { border-color: var(--danger); }
    .field input.valid  { border-color: var(--success); }

    /* Promo row */
    .promo-row {
      display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-end;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .promo-row .field { flex: 1; }

    .btn-apply {
      padding: 13px 28px;
      background: var(--navy); color: var(--white);
      border: none; border-radius: 11px;
      font-size: .93rem; font-weight: 600;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
    }
    .btn-apply:hover { background: #1a3055; transform: translateY(-1px); }

    /* Promo feedback */
    .promo-feedback {
      font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600;
      padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 9px;
      margin-bottom: 20px; display: none;
      align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    }
    .promo-feedback.show { display: flex; }
    .promo-feedback.invalid { background: #fef2f2; color: var(--danger); border: 1px solid #fecaca; }
    .promo-feedback.valid   { background: #f0fdf4; color: #166534;       border: 1px solid #bbf7d0; }

    /* Divider */
    .calc-divider { border: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); margin: 0 0 24px; }

    /* Price summary */
    .price-summary {
      background: var(--grey);
      border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px;
    }
    .price-summary h4 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 16px; text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
    }
    .price-row {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-size: .93rem;
    }
    .price-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
    .price-label { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
    .price-value { font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); font-size: 1rem; }
    .price-row.discount .price-value { color: var(--success); }
    .price-row.total {
      margin-top: 4px; padding-top: 14px;
      border-top: 2px solid var(--border);
    }
    .price-row.total .price-label { font-weight: 700; color: var(--navy); font-size: 1rem; }
    .price-row.total .price-value {
      font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--teal);
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
    }

    /* Applied badge */
    .applied-badge {
      display: none; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      background: var(--teal-lite); border: 1px solid #99f6e4;
      color: var(--teal-dark); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700;
      padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 20px; margin-bottom: 16px;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
    }
    .applied-badge.show { display: inline-flex; }

    /* ============================================================
       MOBILE PERKS SECTION
    ============================================================ */
    .perks-section { margin-bottom: 52px; }

    .perks-grid {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 20px;
    }

    /* Student discount highlight card */
    .perk-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 18px rgba(16,29,50,.08);
      transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
    }
    .perk-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(16,29,50,.13); }

    .perk-card.highlight {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, #1b3058 100%);
      color: var(--white);
    }
    .perk-card.highlight .perk-label { color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); }

    .perk-icon { font-size: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .perk-pct {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2.4rem; font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--teal); line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .perk-card.highlight .perk-pct { color: var(--amber); }
    .perk-name {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .perk-label { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.55; }

    /* Price card */
    .final-price-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal) 0%, var(--teal-dark) 100%);
      border-radius: 20px; padding: 28px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(20,184,166,.25);
      color: var(--white);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
    }
    .fpc-label {
      font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em;
      opacity: .75; margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .fpc-price {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 2.2rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    .fpc-note { font-size: .82rem; opacity: .75; }
    .fpc-saving {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);
      padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700;
      margin-top: 12px; align-self: flex-start;
    }

    /* ============================================================
       HOW IT WORKS
    ============================================================ */
    .how-section { margin-bottom: 52px; }

    .steps-row {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 16px;
    }
    .step-card {
      background: var(--white); border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 24px 20px; text-align: center;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(16,29,50,.07);
      transition: transform .22s;
    }
    .step-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }
    .step-num {
      width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--navy); color: var(--white);
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: .95rem;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 12px;
    }
    .step-title { font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: .93rem; color: var(--navy); margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .step-desc  { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.55; }

    /* ============================================================
       BOTTOM CTA
    ============================================================ */
    .cta-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, #1b3058 100%);
      border-radius: 20px; padding: 44px 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    .cta-banner h3 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .cta-banner p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.65); font-size: .95rem; margin-bottom: 26px; }
    .btn-cta {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      background: var(--teal); color: var(--white);
      border: none; padding: 13px 28px; border-radius: 26px;
      font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s, transform .15s;
    }
    .btn-cta:hover { background: var(--teal-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); }

    /* ============================================================
       FOOTER
    ============================================================ */
    footer { background: #0a1221; color: var(--white); padding: 52px 24px 36px; }
    .foot-inner {
      max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.9fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px;
    }
    .foot-brand h2 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em;
      color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .foot-brand p { color: rgba(255,255,255,.58); font-size: .88rem; line-height: 1.72; margin-bottom: 20px; max-width: 290px; }
    .foot-copy { color: rgba(255,255,255,.35); font-size: .8rem; }
    .foot-col h4 {
      font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    .foot-col ul { list-style: none; }
    .foot-col ul li { margin-bottom: 11px; }
    .foot-col ul li a { color: rgba(255,255,255,.62); text-decoration: none; font-size: .88rem; transition: color .2s; }
    .foot-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--teal); }

    /* ============================================================
       TOAST
    ============================================================ */
    .toast {
      position: fixed; bottom: 28px; right: 28px;
      background: var(--navy); color: var(--white);
      padding: 14px 20px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: .88rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.26);
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; z-index: 9999;
      transform: translateY(90px); opacity: 0;
      transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), opacity .35s;
      border-left: 4px solid var(--teal); max-width: 320px;
    }
    .toast.show { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }

    /* ============================================================
       RESPONSIVE
    ============================================================ */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .steps-row { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .offers-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .perks-grid  { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-links, .btn-book { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .nav-wrap { justify-content: space-between; }

      .foot-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
      .offers-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .calc-inputs { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .promo-row { flex-direction: column; }
      .btn-apply { width: 100%; }
      .steps-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .page-h1 { font-size: 1.8rem; }
      .cta-banner { padding: 32px 20px; }
      .calc-card { padding: 24px 20px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      main { padding: 28px 16px 48px; }
      .perks-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
  </style>
