<script>
  'use strict';

  /* ─── Valid promo codes ──────────────────────────────────────── */
  const PROMO_CODES = {
    'WEEKEND10': { discount: 10, label: 'Weekend Deal (10% off)' },
    'STUDENT15': { discount: 15, label: 'Student Discount (15% off)' },
    'SPECIAL20': { discount: 20, label: 'Special Offer (20% off)' }
  };

  const LS_KEY = 'rr_applied_promos';

  /* ─── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let currentDiscount = 0;   // percent
  let currentCode     = '';

  /* ─── Format PKR ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function formatPKR(val) {
    return 'PKR ' + Math.round(val).toLocaleString('en-PK');
  }

  /* ─── Recalculate prices ─────────────────────────────────────── */
  function recalculate() {
    const days = parseFloat(document.getElementById('rentalDays').value) || 0;
    const rate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('dailyRate').value)  || 0;

    const subtotal     = days * rate;
    const discountAmt  = subtotal * (currentDiscount / 100);
    const finalTotal   = subtotal - discountAmt;

    // Summary card
    document.getElementById('summDays').textContent     = days + (days === 1 ? ' day' : ' days');
    document.getElementById('summRate').textContent     = formatPKR(rate);
    document.getElementById('summSubtotal').textContent = formatPKR(subtotal);
    document.getElementById('summDiscPct').textContent  = currentDiscount;
    document.getElementById('summDiscount').textContent = '– ' + formatPKR(discountAmt);
    document.getElementById('summTotal').textContent    = formatPKR(finalTotal);

    // Live final price card
    document.getElementById('fpcPrice').textContent = formatPKR(finalTotal);
    document.getElementById('fpcNote').textContent  = days > 0
      ? (currentDiscount > 0 ? currentDiscount + '% discount applied!' : 'No discount applied yet.')
      : 'Enter rental days above to calculate';

    const savingEl = document.getElementById('fpcSaving');
    if (discountAmt > 0 && days > 0) {
      savingEl.style.display = 'inline-flex';
      document.getElementById('fpcSaveAmt').textContent = formatPKR(discountAmt);
    } else {
      savingEl.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  /* ─── Apply promo code ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  function applyPromo() {
    const input    = document.getElementById('promoCode');
    const code     = input.value.trim().toUpperCase();
    const feedback = document.getElementById('promoFeedback');
    const badge    = document.getElementById('appliedBadge');
    const codeInp  = document.getElementById('promoCode');

    // Clear previous states
    feedback.className  = 'promo-feedback';
    feedback.textContent = '';
    codeInp.classList.remove('error', 'valid');

    if (!code) {
      setFeedback('invalid', '⚠️ Please enter a promo code first.');
      codeInp.classList.add('error');
      codeInp.focus();
      return;
    }

    if (PROMO_CODES[code]) {
      const promo = PROMO_CODES[code];
      currentDiscount = promo.discount;
      currentCode     = code;

      // Update UI
      codeInp.classList.add('valid');
      setFeedback('valid', '🎉 Promo code accepted! ' + promo.label + ' applied.');
      badge.classList.add('show');
      document.getElementById('appliedCodeLabel').textContent = code;

      // Persist to localStorage
      saveAppliedCode(code, promo);

      recalculate();
      showToast('✨ ' + promo.label + ' applied successfully!');
    } else {
      currentDiscount = 0;
      currentCode     = '';
      codeInp.classList.add('error');
      setFeedback('invalid', '❌ Invalid promo code. Please try again.');
      badge.classList.remove('show');
      document.getElementById('appliedCodeLabel').textContent = '';
      recalculate();
    }
  }

  function setFeedback(type, msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('promoFeedback');
    el.className   = 'promo-feedback show ' + type;
    el.textContent = msg;
  }

  /* ─── localStorage ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  function saveAppliedCode(code, promo) {
    try {
      let history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY) || '[]');
      // Avoid duplicate entries for the same code
      if (!history.find(h => h.code === code)) {
        history.push({
          code,
          label:     promo.label,
          discount:  promo.discount,
          appliedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        });
        localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify(history));
      }
    } catch(e) {}
  }

  /* ─── Copy code to clipboard ─────────────────────────────────── */
  function copyCode(code) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
        showToast('📋 Code "' + code + '" copied to clipboard!');
        // Auto-fill the promo input
        document.getElementById('promoCode').value = code;
      });
    } else {
      // Fallback
      document.getElementById('promoCode').value = code;
      showToast('📋 Code "' + code + '" pasted into the calculator!');
    }
  }

  /* ─── Toast ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  let _toastTimer;
  function showToast(msg) {
    const el = document.getElementById('toast');
    document.getElementById('toastMsg').textContent = msg;
    el.classList.add('show');
    clearTimeout(_toastTimer);
    _toastTimer = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
  }

  /* ─── More dropdown ──────────────────────────────────────────── */
  const moreBtn  = document.getElementById('moreBtn');
  const megaMenu = document.getElementById('megaMenu');
  moreBtn.addEventListener('click', e => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const open = megaMenu.classList.toggle('open');
    moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    megaMenu.classList.remove('open');
    moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  });
  megaMenu.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { megaMenu.classList.remove('open'); moreBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); }
  });

  /* ─── Hamburger ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('hamburger').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const nav  = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const btn  = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const open = nav.classList.toggle('open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });

  /* ─── Enter key on promo field ───────────────────────────────── */
  document.getElementById('promoCode').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') applyPromo();
  });

  /* ─── Init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
  recalculate();
</script>
